factories.name: newSearchPagesStep
factories.description: Search one bounded page of Confluence pages with a typed, connector-escaped CQL filter for space, title, label, and modification time plus an optional bounded CQL clause, continuing with the search cursor.

PageSearchFilter.description: PageSearchFilter is a typed page search that the connector turns into escaped CQL, so no caller text can change the query's structure. The query always starts with type = page, and every set field adds one clause joined with AND.

additionalCql.description: AdditionalCQL is one caller-built clause ANDed inside parentheses, such as ancestor = 123456 OR parent = 123456. It must balance its parentheses and quotes and cannot contain ORDER BY. Quote every value that came from outside the application with QuoteCQLString.

labels.description: Labels matches pages that carry at least one of these labels, such as policy or in-force.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince keeps only pages last modified at or after this instant. CQL compares dates in the authorizing user's Confluence time zone, so the connector widens the CQL bound by half a day and removes earlier pages from each result page itself.

order.description: Order selects the result order; blank uses PageSearchOrderLastModifiedDescending.

spaceKeys.description: SpaceKeys limits the search to these space keys, such as OPS or ~5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5.

titlePhrase.description: TitlePhrase matches pages whose title contains this phrase as Confluence's text search tokenizes it. Text search ignores case and punctuation, so compare the returned titles for an exact match.

inputSchema.description: SearchPagesInput selects one page of search results.

cursor.description: Cursor continues a previous search with the same filter; blank reads the first page.

filter.description: Filter is the typed search the connector escapes into CQL.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of pages to request, 1 to 100; zero requests 25. Confluence may return fewer.

factories.name: newGetPageStep
factories.description: Read one page by ID with its current version number and its storage or Atlassian Document Format body converted to bounded Markdown or plain text.

inputSchema.description: GetPageInput identifies one page and how to return its body.

bodyFormat.description: BodyFormat selects the returned text; blank returns Markdown.

bodyRepresentation.description: BodyRepresentation selects the Confluence body to convert; blank reads storage format.

maxBodyCharacters.description: MaxBodyCharacters cuts Body after this many characters, 1 to 131072; zero keeps 32768.

pageId.description: PageID is the numeric page ID, such as 123456.

factories.name: newCreatePageStep
factories.description: Publish one page in a space, optionally below a parent page, with a Markdown or plain-text body converted to storage format; Confluence allows one page per title in a space, so a repeated create finds the page instead of adding another.

inputSchema.description: CreatePageInput describes one published page. Set exactly one of SpaceID and SpaceKey.

body.description: Body is the page content of at most 262144 characters in BodyFormat.

bodyFormat.description: BodyFormat is the format of Body; blank reads Markdown.

parentPageId.description: ParentPageID places the page below this page in the same space; blank uses the space homepage.

spaceId.description: SpaceID is the numeric space ID, as the space picker stores it.

spaceKey.description: SpaceKey is the space key, such as OPS; the connector looks up its ID before creating.

title.description: Title is the one-line page title, at most 255 characters. Confluence allows one page per title in a space.

factories.name: newUpdatePageStep
factories.description: Replace one page's title and body as the next version, which the caller names; a repeated update finds its own version instead of failing, and a version another editor made is reported as a conflict.

inputSchema.description: UpdatePageInput replaces one page's title and body as the next version.

body.description: Body is the complete new page content of at most 262144 characters in BodyFormat.

bodyFormat.description: BodyFormat is the format of Body; blank reads Markdown.

nextVersionNumber.description: NextVersionNumber is the version this update creates: the version number getPage returned plus one. Confluence refuses it when another edit saved that version first.

pageId.description: PageID is the numeric page ID, such as 123456.

title.description: Title is the page title after the update, one line of at most 255 characters; repeat the current title to keep it.

versionMessage.description: VersionMessage is an optional one-line change summary of at most 200 characters, shown in page history. The connector appends a marker such as [dex:3f9a2c1b7e04d5a6] to recognize its own update.

factories.name: newAddCommentStep
factories.description: Add one footer comment with a Markdown or plain-text body to a page, sending it at most once per Step execution and confirming an unconfirmed attempt by reading the page's comments.

inputSchema.description: AddCommentInput describes one footer comment on one page.

body.description: Body is the comment of at most 262144 characters in BodyFormat.

bodyFormat.description: BodyFormat is the format of Body; blank reads Markdown.

pageId.description: PageID is the numeric page ID, such as 123456.
